## Professional Summary

Sadia Khan is a results-driven Full Stack Developer and AI Automation Engineer with 4+ years of professional engineering experience. She specializes in architecting, developing, and deploying resilient web applications, cross-platform mobile apps, cloud backends, and AI-powered workflow automations. 

Adhering to German engineering standards—including Clean Code, scalable domain-driven architecture, robust automated testing, and strict GDPR (DSGVO) compliance—Sadia combines engineering rigor with intuitive user experiences.

## Key Production Projects (Selected Highlights)

Sadia Khan has engineered and delivered 20+ production-grade software solutions across MedTech, AI, SaaS, and Enterprise domains:

1. **DigiHomeo (AI & MedTech)**
   - *Role*: Full Stack AI Engineer (Flutter, Dart, Firebase, GCP, MedGemma)
   - *Description*: AI-powered clinical decision support system for medical and homeopathic practitioners to analyze multi-symptomatic patient cases in real-time.
   - *Links*: https://digihomeo.com · Google Play Store

2. **GynaeHub (HealthTech & Clinical Workflow)**
   - *Role*: Full Stack Developer (React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Docker)
   - *Description*: Comprehensive clinical management platform for obstetrics & gynecology, supporting patient health records, appointment scheduling, and HIPAA/GDPR compliance.
   - *Links*: https://gynaehub.com

3. **Medical Research Council Platform (MRC)**
   - *Role*: Lead Frontend Engineer (Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS)
   - *Description*: Research repository and collaboration portal for medical investigators, enabling secure data sharing and peer review.

4. **University of East Anglia Research Portal (UEAR)**
   - *Role*: Full Stack Engineer (Python, Django, React, PostgreSQL)
   - *Description*: Academic research repository and publication catalog for university researchers and students.
